mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_requests (id, from_user, to_user, message, status, luna_cost, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{fromUser}, #{toUser}, #{message}, #{status}, #{lunaCost}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_requests SET status = #{status}, responded_at = #{respondedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_requests WHERE from_user = #{fromUser} AND to_user = #{toUser} AND status = 'REJECTED' AND responded_at IS NOT NULL AND responded_at > #{since})

SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS partner_nickname, u.birth_year AS partner_birth_year, u.country AS partner_country, p.photo_key AS partner_photo_key FROM chat_requests r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.from_user LEFT JOIN user_profiles p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE r.to_user = #{userId} AND r.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_requests WHERE from_user = #{fromUser} AND to_user = #{toUser} AND status = 'PENDING')
SELECT * FROM chat_requests WHERE from_user = #{fromUser} AND to_user = #{toUser} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms (id, user_a, user_b, status, type, request_id, active_pair_key, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userA}, #{userB}, #{status}, #{type}, #{requestId}, CONCAT(LEAST(#{userA}, #{userB}), '_', GREATEST(#{userA}, #{userB})), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS room_id, r.status, r.type, u.id AS partner_id, u.nickname AS partner_nickname, u.birth_year AS partner_birth_year, u.country AS partner_country, pr.photo_key AS partner_photo_key, (SELECT m.body FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.room_id = r.id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message, (SELECT m.type FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.room_id = r.id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_type, (SELECT m.created_at FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.room_id = r.id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.room_id = r.id AND m.sender_id != #{userId} AND m.read_at IS NULL) AS unread_count FROM chat_rooms r JOIN users u ON u.id = CASE WHEN r.user_a = #{userId} THEN r.user_b ELSE r.user_a END LEFT JOIN user_profiles pr ON pr.user_id = u.id WHERE (r.user_a = #{userId} OR r.user_b = #{userId}) AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY last_message_at IS NULL, last_message_at DESC, r.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM chat_rooms WHERE active_pair_key = #{pairKey} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT * FROM chat_rooms WHERE active_pair_key = #{pairKey} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND type = #{type}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_rooms SET type = #{type} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (id, room_id, sender_id, type, body, audio_key, audio_duration_ms, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{body}, #{audioKey}, #{audioDurationMs}, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND sender_id != #{readerId} AND read_at IS NULL
